entries.en: Amalia chose the shaded bench rather than the sunny steps.
entries.zh: 阿玛莉亚选择了阴凉处的长椅，而没有坐在晒着太阳的台阶上。

entries.en: Her fictional retelling introduces Aman in the opening scene.
entries.zh: 她的虚构改写在开场就引入了哈曼这个人物。

entries.en: Amana brought a spare towel for the muddy dog.
entries.zh: 阿马纳给沾满泥的狗多带了一条毛巾。

entries.en: Amanar asked the shopkeeper to keep the parcel until Monday.
entries.zh: 阿默讷尔请店主把包裹保管到周一。

entries.en: Amancio moved the wet coats away from the painted wall.
entries.zh: 阿曼西奥把湿外套挪离了刷好漆的墙面。

entries.en: Amani collected the empty plates while the others made tea.
entries.zh: 其他人沏茶时，阿马尼收起了空盘子。

entries.en: Amann asked whether the broken handle could be repaired today.
entries.zh: 阿曼问那个坏掉的把手今天能否修好。

entries.en: In the imagined scene, Amanpour searches her bag for the missing keys.
entries.zh: 在这个想象的场景中，阿曼普尔翻包寻找丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: Amant saved the final piece of ribbon for the smaller parcel.
entries.zh: 阿芒把最后一截缎带留给了那个较小的包裹。

entries.en: Amantes checked the garden gate before letting the dog outside.
entries.zh: 阿曼特斯先检查了花园大门，再把狗放到外面。

entries.en: The two amanuenses compared their copies before returning the original manuscript.
entries.zh: 两位抄写员归还原稿前，先核对了各自的抄本。

entries.en: Amanullah put the borrowed camera back in its padded case.
entries.zh: 阿马努拉把借来的相机放回了有衬垫的相机包。

entries.en: Amar remembered to take a torch for the dark path home.
entries.zh: 艾玛尔记得带上手电筒，以便走那条漆黑的回家路。

entries.en: Amaral found the torn page tucked inside a later chapter.
entries.zh: 阿马拉尔发现那张破损的书页夹在了后面的一个章节里。

entries.en: Amarante brought enough paper cups for the entire rehearsal group.
entries.zh: 阿马兰特带来了足够的纸杯，供整个排练小组使用。

entries.en: Amare tied a bright scarf around the handle of the borrowed suitcase.
entries.zh: 阿马雷在借来的行李箱提手上系了一条鲜艳的围巾。

entries.meaningZh: 意大利杏仁味小饼干〔复数〕
entries.en: She served the coffee with two amaretti on a small plate.
entries.zh: 她端上咖啡时，还用小盘子配了两块意大利杏仁味小饼干。

entries.en: Amari moved the flowers to a cooler room before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人们到来前，阿马里把花搬到了一间更凉快的房间。

entries.en: Their friends in Amarillo offered to look after the borrowed van.
entries.zh: 他们在阿马里洛的朋友提出帮忙照看借来的货车。

entries.en: The museum displayed a small map showing the site of Amarna.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一张小地图，上面标着阿马尔那的位置。

entries.en: Amaro left a note explaining where the spare blankets were kept.
entries.zh: 阿马罗留了张便条，说明备用毯子放在哪里。

entries.en: The illustrator placed Amasa beside the doorway in the imagined scene.
entries.zh: 插画师在那个想象的场景里把亚玛撒画在了门口。

entries.en: She poured amasi into a bowl and added a spoonful of sugar.
entries.zh: 她把酸牛奶倒进碗里，加了一勺糖。

entries.meaningZh: 调色刮刀〔历史绘画工具〕
entries.en: The painter scraped the remaining pigment together with an amassette.
entries.zh: 画家用调色刮刀把剩余的颜料刮拢起来。

entries.en: The council questioned the owner's amassment of so many unused properties.
entries.zh: 市政当局对那位业主聚积如此多闲置房产提出了质疑。

entries.en: Amat kept the damaged chair out of reach of the children.
entries.zh: 阿马特把坏掉的椅子放在了孩子们够不着的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 天照大神〔日本神话神名〕
entries.en: The exhibition included a painting of Amaterasu beside a narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 展览中有一幅天照大神的画作，放在一个狭窄的门口旁。

entries.en: The club checked her amateurship before accepting the competition entry.
entries.zh: 俱乐部接受她的参赛报名之前，先核查了她的业余选手身份。

entries.en: Amau checked that the windows were shut before the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨到来前，天羽检查了窗户是否关好。

entries.en: The café served warm amazake in small ceramic cups.
entries.zh: 那家咖啡馆用小陶瓷杯供应温热的日本甘酒。

entries.en: The jeweller set a piece of amazonite into the silver pendant.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠把一块天河石嵌进了银吊坠。

entries.en: Ambar offered to watch the luggage while we bought lunch.
entries.zh: 我们买午饭时，安巴尔提出帮忙照看行李。

entries.en: The workers bundled the harvested ambary beside the field.
entries.zh: 工人们在田边把收割的洋麻捆成了捆。

entries.en: Ambassa remembered the spare key only after the door had closed.
entries.zh: 门关上以后，安巴萨才想起备用钥匙。

entries.en: The ambassador-at-large visited several capitals during the negotiations.
entries.zh: 谈判期间，那位巡回大使走访了几座首都。

entries.en: In the imagined dialogue, Ambedkar asks for the letter to be read again.
entries.zh: 在这段想象的对话中，安贝德卡要求再读一遍那封信。

entries.en: An old tin on the porch was stained with ambeer.
entries.zh: 门廊上的一个旧罐子沾着烟草汁。

entries.en: Amberg kept a spare pair of gloves in the bicycle basket.
entries.zh: 安伯格在自行车篮里放了一副备用手套。

entries.en: The cabinet contained two amberina vases and a chipped glass plate.
entries.zh: 柜子里有两个美国艺术玻璃花瓶和一个带缺口的玻璃盘。

entries.en: The ambiguousness of the instructions caused two teams to repeat the same work.
entries.zh: 指示含混不清，导致两个团队重复做了同样的工作。

entries.en: The engineer mixed the forest recording in ambisonics before preparing a stereo version.
entries.zh: 工程师先用 Ambisonics 声场录放技术混制了那段森林录音，再准备立体声版本。

entries.en: The lost suitcase finally reached their hotel in Amboise.
entries.zh: 丢失的行李箱终于送到了他们在安博瓦兹入住的酒店。

entries.en: Ambre made room in the cupboard for the borrowed dishes.
entries.zh: 安布尔在碗柜里腾出空间，放借来的餐具。

entries.en: A conservator catalogued the contents of both ambries during the chapel survey.
entries.zh: 一位修复师在勘查小礼拜堂时，登记了两个圣器壁龛中的物品。

entries.en: Ambrosio carried the last crate into the cool storeroom.
entries.zh: 安布罗西奥把最后一只板条箱搬进了凉爽的储藏室。

entries.meaningZh: 玻璃底片制成的旧式照片〔摄影史〕
entries.en: The family portrait survived as an ambrotype in a velvet-lined case.
entries.zh: 那幅采用玻璃底片制成的全家福照片，装在衬有天鹅绒的盒子里保存了下来。

entries.en: The chapel's silver cup was kept in a locked ambry.
entries.zh: 小礼拜堂的银杯保存在一个上锁的圣器壁龛里。

entries.meaningZh: 揽讼律师〔美式贬义，复数〕
entries.en: The injured cyclist resented the ambulance-chasers who kept offering legal help.
entries.zh: 那位受伤的骑车人讨厌那些不断主动提供法律帮助的揽讼律师。

entries.en: With an ambulator, the surveyor measured the length of the path.
entries.zh: 测量员用测程轮测量了那条小路的长度。

entries.en: The survey crew checked both ambulators against the same measured distance.
entries.zh: 勘测队用同一段已知距离核查了两台测距仪。

entries.en: The ambulette arrived to take our elderly neighbour to her clinic appointment.
entries.zh: 接送病人的轻型车辆来了，准备送我们年迈的邻居去诊所赴约。

entries.en: The novel describes an ambuscado on the narrow mountain road.
entries.zh: 小说描述了一场发生在狭窄山路上的伏击。

entries.en: The captain feared an ambushment along the unlit road.
entries.zh: 队长担心那条没有照明的路上会有伏击。

entries.en: Amdam asked the caretaker to leave the side entrance unlocked.
entries.zh: 阿姆丹请管理员不要锁上侧门。

entries.en: The pupils watched amebae move in a drop of pond water.
entries.zh: 学生们看着一滴池水中的变形虫移动。

entries.en: Ameen saved the larger carton for the fragile lampshade.
entries.zh: 阿明把较大的纸箱留给了易碎的灯罩。

entries.en: Amelio checked the address on the envelope before posting it.
entries.zh: 阿梅利奥在寄信之前核对了信封上的地址。

entries.en: The farmers compared untreated soil with soil containing the ameliorant.
entries.zh: 农民们把未处理的土壤与含有改良物的土壤进行了比较。

entries.en: The reformer wanted recognition as an ameliorator of working conditions.
entries.zh: 那位改革者希望以工作条件改善者的身份获得认可。

entries.en: Amena remembered to label the sandwiches before the picnic.
entries.zh: 阿梅娜记得在野餐前给三明治贴好了标签。

entries.en: The final amender removed an inconsistency that earlier readers had missed.
entries.zh: 最后那位修正者消除了先前读者们没有注意到的一处矛盾。

entries.en: Amendola moved the table away from the leaking window.
entries.zh: 阿门多拉把桌子挪离了漏雨的窗户。

entries.en: Ameno placed the spare tickets beneath the kitchen clock.
entries.zh: 饴野把多余的票放在了厨房时钟下面。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the amenta before collecting the fallen leaves.
entries.zh: 植物学家先拍下了柔荑花序，然后收集了落叶。

entries.en: The archive contains interviews with Amerasians from different generations.
entries.zh: 档案中收录了对不同世代的美亚混血者的访谈。

entries.en: Ameri collected the wet towels and hung them beneath the shelter.
entries.zh: 阿米里收起湿毛巾，把它们晾在了遮蔽物下。

entries.en: Her essay explores American-ness through food and family traditions.
entries.zh: 她的文章通过饮食与家庭传统探讨美国性。

entries.en: The review criticises the Americanisation of the film's dialogue.
entries.zh: 那篇影评批评了电影对白的美国化处理。

entries.en: I'll have an americano and a small glass of water.
entries.zh: 我要一杯美式咖啡和一小杯水。

entries.en: Her course in Americanology combined history with the study of contemporary culture.
entries.zh: 她的美国学课程把历史与当代文化研究结合了起来。

entries.en: Two americanos stood untouched on the café counter.
entries.zh: 两杯美式咖啡放在咖啡馆柜台上，一口也没动。

entries.en: Amerman put the returned books on a separate shelf.
entries.zh: 阿默曼把归还的书放在了单独的架子上。

entries.en: Amerson kept the spare chairs near the back of the hall.
entries.zh: 阿默森把备用椅子放在了礼堂后部附近。

entries.en: The geologist identified amesite in the rock from the old quarry.
entries.zh: 地质学家在来自旧采石场的岩石中辨认出了镁绿泥石。

entries.meaningZh: 无变态性〔昆虫生长方式〕
entries.en: The diagram illustrates ametabolism by following an insect from hatching to adulthood.
entries.zh: 示意图通过展示一只昆虫从孵化到成年的过程，说明无变态性这一生长方式。

entries.en: Amey wrapped the broken tile to keep its sharp edges covered.
entries.zh: 埃米包好了破瓷砖，遮住了锋利的边缘。

entries.en: Amia carried a second blanket for the evening ferry journey.
entries.zh: 埃米娅为傍晚的渡轮旅程多带了一条毯子。

entries.meaningZh: 神职人员的白麻布披巾
entries.en: Before the service, the priest put on a clean amice.
entries.zh: 礼拜开始前，神父披上了一块干净的白麻布披巾。

entries.en: Amichai put the unsigned forms back in the blue folder.
entries.zh: 阿米凯把没有签字的表格放回了蓝色文件夹。

entries.en: The painting shows Amida seated beneath a decorated canopy.
entries.zh: 画中，阿弥陀佛坐在一顶装饰过的华盖下。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米达祷告〔犹太教祷告名〕
entries.en: The congregation stood quietly during the Amidah.
entries.zh: 会众在阿米达祷告期间安静地站着。

entries.en: The analysis detected amidobenzene in one of the stored samples.
entries.zh: 分析在一份存放的样品中检测出了苯胺。

entries.en: The researchers followed amidolysis by measuring the products released during the reaction.
entries.zh: 研究人员通过测量反应中释放的产物，追踪酰胺分解过程。

entries.en: The authors compared two routes to amidomethylation of the compound.
entries.zh: 作者们比较了对该化合物进行酰胺甲基化的两条路线。

entries.en: The chemist compared the amidopurine sample with a reference material.
entries.zh: 化学家把那份腺嘌呤样品与参照材料进行了比较。

entries.en: The demonstration used amidulin instead of the untreated starch from the cupboard.
entries.zh: 演示使用了可溶性淀粉，而没有使用碗柜里未经处理的淀粉。

entries.en: Amiel asked everyone to check beneath their seats for the missing scarf.
entries.zh: 埃米尔请大家检查座位下面，找找那条丢失的围巾。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米克〔奥运会吉祥物名〕
entries.en: The children drew Amik on postcards for the display.
entries.zh: 孩子们在明信片上画了阿米克，准备用于展示。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the amil arrives before the harvest has been stored.
entries.zh: 在这部历史小说中，收税员在收获物入库之前就来了。

entries.en: Amilcar replaced the torn label before sending the suitcase onward.
entries.zh: 阿米尔卡更换了撕破的标签，然后把行李箱继续送走。

entries.en: Amina kept the empty boxes for the following day's move.
entries.zh: 阿明娜把空箱子留给了第二天的搬家。

entries.en: Aminah carried the extra cushions into the room for the visitors.
entries.zh: 阿米娜把额外的垫子拿进房间，供访客们使用。

entries.en: Aminata checked the spare tyre before the long drive.
entries.zh: 阿米纳塔在长途驾车之前检查了备用轮胎。

entries.en: Amini put a strip of tape across the cracked lid.
entries.zh: 阿米尼在裂开的盖子上贴了一条胶带。
